rows.en: Just like your second helpings, [HERO4], huh?
Geez, at a time like this… [HERO2], you meanie!
…!? Cap, it's Hayata! He's heading for S16 in a boat.
Muramatsu to Hayata, Muramatsu to Hayata! Where on earth have you been all this time? We've been searching for you since last night!
I'm sorry for wrecking our precious VTOL.
What on earth happened last night? How did you survive the VTOL crash?
He saved me.
He… Who's "he"?
Cap, never mind that. First we have to take down Bemular.
Bemular? What's this Bemular?

It's a kaiju sleeping in the lake. If we let our guard down, we'll be in for it.

I'll go out on the lake in S16 and catch it asleep while it's worn out from its long journey through space.

When it jumps out, hit it from above with the VTOL.
All right, got it! Fuji, stop dawdling and land the VTOL next to us!
Roger, roger!
Right… Arashi and Ide, search from the ground!
Still no sign of Bemular? We're ready here!

…!?

Hayata to VTOL… Bemular sighted!!
Right… Ultra Operation No. 1, commence attack!
It's Bemular!
Fire!!
Uwaaaagh…

"Hayata, entrusted with the life of the alien from the M78 Nebula… used the Beta Capsule to transform into that alien!

He became an immortal man who flies through the sky at Mach 5 and smashes every enemy with mighty energy! Go get 'em! Our hero!!"
Wh… what is that!?
…!? It does not appear to be… an enemy.
Huh!? It doesn't look like it's… an enemy, but…

Hahaha… Where's Goro Watari? Did my poison eat him up and kill him?

You'll die too! Take my thorns!
Wait!
Nngh… Sanagiman!? When did you transform?
Fight poison with poison! Toge Banbara! Prepare yourself!
Warrior of freedom! [VAR6]!
Goro!? The poisonous herb worked, didn't it? Thank goodness…
Goro! I always figured you were the type who wouldn't die even if somebody killed you… I'm really glad.
Goro!? Thank goodness! My power was some use after all…
Goro! I believed in you… I knew you'd pull through, I just knew it!

Mr. Tachibana told me what happened! Thank you so much…

Toge Banbara! I'll never forgive the likes of you! I'll send you to hell!!
Nngh… Insolent fools! Get them!!
Wh-what's that? That lamp on the alien's chest… it changed color!
A danger signal, I bet. A red lamp means the same thing everywhere.
How could you possibly know that?
But he looks like he's in a real hurry… Ah! The blinking's getting faster and faster!
Looks like his energy is running out.
Curse you… You'll pay for this, [VAR6]!!
All riiight! Way to go!
Ah, here comes Hayata running! Heeey!!
Heeey!
Hayata! Are you okay?
As you can see, fit as a fiddle.
Hayata… Are you really the real Hayata?

There's no real or fake… There's only one of me.

Cap… by the way, what happened to Bemular?
Mm… The alien chased it off for us.
So he did show up… I thought he might, so I wasn't worried.
Then the one who saved you was…
Him…
Wh-wh-whoa, hold on! You keep saying "him, him" like you're old pals, but what's his name, anyway?
He doesn't have a name.
Come off it! There's no such thing as a guy with no name.
Hmm, let's see… Then how about "Ultraman"?
Ultraman?
Yeah, Ultraman… How's that?
Ultraman… A perfect name for that giant, isn't it?
Ultraman… That's a nice name, huh?
Huh? And who are you guys?
I'm Goro Watari. I'm fighting the Neo-Human Empire.
I see… So you're the TDF special detachment? We've heard all about your exploits.

Yes…

Anyway… that Ultraman is a strong ally, isn't he? It's reassuring to have him around!
But Ultraman… hasn't he gone off somewhere?
He's not going anywhere. His spaceship exploded, so he can't go back to his own planet…
Hmm… You really do have the devil's own luck.
I'm immortal, Cap…

Yeah… He's most likely Ultraman!

But… let's keep quiet about it until he brings it up himself.
Hey… [HERO2]? Hayata is probably…

Well, I guess so…

But… keep that tucked away in your belly, okay?
Not my belly… my chest! My chest! B-U-S-T!!

Hahaha…

But… there's not much room in there to tuck anything away, is there? In that bust?
Wh-! [HERO2]!!
Hahahaha…
Bemular was only the beginning… Countless vicious kaiju lie in wait out in space, and on this Earth as well.
The TDF's upper echelons acted as a bridge between the Space Sheriffs and Riders and the Science Patrol.
It was the moment the Science Patrol's name was recognized by the world as a special unit for countering kaiju.
And so, the names of those five and of Ultraman were added to the history of the great war.
"Takeshi Hongo: Rider 1 is abroad" "Hayato Ichimonji: Rider 2 is abroad"

uncertain: U03370: おかわり (second helpings) joke answering 'this will never end' in U03369.
U03390: narration wrapped in 『』 rendered in double quotes.
U03440-U03442: belly/chest pun (腹にしまう = keep it to yourself) kept literal so the bust joke works; the teasing is kept at full strength.
U03449: looks like a developer label (route flags); translated literally.
